title: blockchain-analytics-lab: reproducible studies of blockchain security data, patterns, monitoring and privacy

creators.name: Kuznetsov, Oleksandr
creators.affiliation: eCampus University, Novedrate (CO), Italy; V.N. Karazin Kharkiv National University, Kharkiv, Ukraine

description:
Reproducible studies of blockchain security data: threat models and incident statistics, AI fundamentals on transaction data, data collection and preprocessing, transaction patterns, streaming monitoring, federated and privacy-preserving detection, and one incident case. Every number comes from a numbered script and is stored with a manifest (code commit, input digests, package versions, configuration).

Licences: code MIT (LICENSE); documentation and result files CC BY 4.0. Third-party datasets are not redistributed and keep their own terms (docs/DATA.md).

Depends on blockchain-detector-eval (pinned commit in pyproject.toml).
